summary.text: Christopher Schulte is the Democratic candidate for North Carolina House of Representatives District 15, running against incumbent Republican Phillip Shepard in the November 3, 2026 general election.
He says in a Ballotpedia survey that he is a psychology professor at Coastal Carolina Community College in Jacksonville, North Carolina.

paragraphs.text: Schulte was born in Dayton, Ohio, and earned an associate degree from Sinclair Community College in 2002, a bachelor's degree from Wright State University in 2004, and a graduate degree from the University of North Texas in 2008.

In his Ballotpedia survey he said he has experience as a mental health counselor and as an advocate for people with mental health disorders and for victims of sexual assault and relationship violence.
He said he lives in Richlands and has been a vice chair of the Onslow County Democratic Party since 2017.
Schulte said he ran for North Carolina House District 4 in 2020.
He lost the general election for District 15 to Shepard in 2022, receiving 31.9 percent of the vote, and again in 2024, receiving 31.2 percent.
He said his key messages include ending gerrymandering and aiming for North Carolina to lead in areas such as per-pupil spending and affordable health care access.
